push.title: L 3-4 vs Los Cottageros | You: 9.0
push.body:
A 9.0, PhogsToffees. You were the steady hand on the wheel tonight.

THE GOOD
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. You made the keeper make decisions, and that's the job.
+ 1 key pass. Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ 1.1 over your typical rating. The work is paying off.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ 28 of the team's 41 passes attempted: the team ran through you. That doesn't happen by accident.

THE BAD
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 2. It happens. It can't keep happening.
- Your 5th straight loss. That's where we are. It's not where we're staying.
- Their humans averaged 10.0 to our 7.8; we were second best man for man. Nobody carries that alone. We carry it as a team.
- Their humans averaged 37 completed passes; you had 24. That's the gap between a good night and a great one.
- Shots: 2. Good, not great yet; top-quarter forwards sit at 3+.

Repetition station: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.

Between you and me, PhogsToffees: You can't rush a good brisket or a good player.

Stay humble, stay hungry. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 3-4 vs Los Cottageros | You: 6.7
push.body:
A 6.7 against Los Cottageros, BellyTb1. Not the movie we wanted, but there's a sequel tomorrow.

THE GOOD
+ 1 assist. You found gaps I didn't know were there, and I was looking.
+ That's a partnership I'd build a team around: you and PhogsToffees.
+ Misplaced passes 3, down from your usual 6. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. That's what showing up looks like.
+ 4 of the team's 6 shots: the team ran through you. You can build a whole match on that.

THE BAD
- Only 13 passes (down from your usual 17). Game plan: Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Write this down: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard. Patience, partner.
- Your 5th straight loss. We'll talk about it as a group, then leave it behind us.
- 4 goals conceded: -0.1. One habit and it's gone.

THE UGLY
! Their best midfielder posted 10.0 to your 6.7. That's the kind of thing that gets you benched on a real team.

Five minutes of this: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Believe it, then go do it.

We'll sharpen it at practice. - Coach Lasso
